name: dovetail-pick
title: Dovetail Pick
description: Segmented control / radio group whose selection indicator is a tapered SVG trapezoid that lifts out of its old slot, slides, and eases down to seat into the chosen one — joinery, not highlighting, with the old label's bold treatment releasing 40ms before the new one lands.
instruction: Segmented control / radio group whose selection indicator is a subtly tapered SVG trapezoid (polygon, non-scaling stroke, fill/stroke from --background and --foreground) that behaves like a fitted joint rather than a highlight pill. On selection change it lifts out of the old slot (an instant, transition-free jump to translateY 0 — the joint opening), then on the next animation frame slides its position/width/height together on one ease-out-expo curve (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), ~260ms) and eases 1px deeper on arrival to seat into the new slot. The trapezoid is inset a few px inside each slot's measured box so a sliver of the slot's own hairline wall (the radiogroup's divide-x dividers) stays visible at rest, keeping the fitted-piece read legible in a single static frame. Labels carry their own half of the choreography: the newly selected label gets a 1px downward nudge plus a font-weight step up to 600 exactly when the trapezoid seats (t=260ms), while the previously selected label releases its own nudge/weight 40ms earlier (t=220ms) — a brief window where neither label reads as seated, which is the whole tell: the old joint visibly opens before the new one closes. Real role=radiogroup of role=radio buttons with roving tabindex: ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down move selection and each move replays the same slide-and-seat sequence, Home/End jump to the first/last option, aria-checked flips the instant a selection commits (independent of the cosmetic seat lag, so assistive tech is never behind the animation), and the group carries an aria-label. Measurement is a small ResizeObserver-driven effect reading each button's offsetLeft/Top/Width/Height; the indicator only re-snaps on resize when idle, never mid-transition. Click and keyboard are the only inputs — no drag, no release velocity, no gesture momentum; that absence of physics is what keeps this distinct from a coast-and-capture drag pill. prefers-reduced-motion: the trapezoid still jumps straight to its 1px-seated resting pose with no slide and no release-lag gap between labels — the seat depth is sub-threshold and non-vestibular, so the fitted look survives even though the motion doesn't. All ink is token-relative (--background/--foreground/--border/--muted; --accent appears only as the focus-visible ring) — pure DOM and SVG, no canvas.
useWhen: Reach for this over fling-segment when the selection should read as a precise, deliberate seating (view switchers, density pickers, billing-cycle toggles) driven purely by click/keyboard with no gesture affordance at all. Pick fling-segment instead when the pill itself should be grabbable and flingable with real release-velocity physics — dovetail-pick has zero drag path by design.
